title: Botany Pots Cobblemon Eggant Berry
description: Allows Cobblemon's Eggant Berries to be grown in Botany Pots.
body:
Allows [Cobblemon's](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) Eggant Berry to be grown in [Botany Pots](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-pots).

This pack is intended to be used alongside of [LayaTweaks BotanyPots](https://modrinth.com/datapack/layatweaks-botanypots) which allows most of Cobblemon's other crops to be grown in Botany Pots.

Also check out [Botany Pots Cobblemon Galarica Nuts](https://modrinth.com/datapack/botany-pots-cobblemon-galarica-nuts)
